segments.name: Northeast
segments.description: Designs, constructs, markets and sells homes for first-time, move-up, luxury, active lifestyle and empty-nester buyers in northeastern states.
segments.evidence: Northeast: Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Virginia and West Virginia

segments.name: Southeast
segments.description: Builds and sells residential homes in planned communities for various buyer types across southeastern states.
segments.evidence: Southeast: Florida, Georgia and South Carolina

segments.name: West

segments.name: Financial Services
segments.description: Provides mortgage banking and title services to customers of the homebuilding operations.
segments.evidence: Our financial services operations, which are a reportable segment, provide mortgage banking and title services to the homebuilding operations' customers.

revenueModel.text: Homebuyers pay the company for homes when control transfers at closing, and mortgage investors buy the mortgage loans the financial services segment originates.
revenueModel.evidence: revenue is recognized when control is transferred to the buyer, which occurs when the buyer takes title to and possession of the home and there is no continuing involvement
